act_descr: Act I — Spring Tide: Appetite and Discovery
chapters: Alma and Signe foraged a predawn skerry and Alma tasted skær that lit a Dragør kitchen memory. [+]
Back at the hall, Kaspar forced NDAs, banned Signe from sharing coordinates, and told Mateo to plan capacity beyond permits. [-]
Alma served “salted kohlrabi, skær, dill pollen” at the May pop-up and diners wept while Leif booked a second seat that week. [+]
Signe refused increased pulls, kept her tide charts closed, and walked out when Kaspar pressed for volumes. [-]
Leif ate the skær course again and filed a spare, ecstatic rave from his Torvehallerne apartment that spiked bookings. [+]
Kaspar installed an unlicensed recirculating skær tank fed by harbor water and told Einar to keep it off the books. [-]
Mateo built a salinity probe that stabilized brines, and Einar timed prep to tide windows so service snapped clean. [+]
A squall hit the harbor, the new tank coughed air, and Kaspar ordered a pump restart over Mateo’s safety protest. [-]
act_scenes:
Chapter 1:
Scene 1:
Characters: Alma, Signe
Place: Low skerry east of Dragør, inshore flats
Time: Predawn, rising spring tide
Event: They wade and hand-pick skær under headlamps.
Conflict: Signe wants to quit before tide turns; Alma pushes for one more patch.
Story value: Discovery
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Briny, alert
Outcome: A small crate of pristine skær and a pinned waypoint.

Scene 2:
Characters: Alma, Signe
Place: Same skerry, windbreak of glacial stones
Time: First light
Event: Alma tastes skær; a Dragør kitchen memory snaps into place.
Conflict: Whether to keep this patch secret between them or loop in Kaspar.
Story value: Identity
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Intimate, electric
Outcome: Alma pockets a sample; they agree to “not yet” on coordinates.

Chapter 2:
Scene 1:
Characters: Kaspar, Alma, Signe, Mateo, Einar, FOH lead
Place: Restaurant hall, office table
Time: Late morning, same day
Event: Kaspar issues NDAs and bans sharing foraging coordinates.
Conflict: Signe challenges the ban; Kaspar threatens to pull her day-rate.
Story value: Autonomy
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Cold, managerial
Outcome: Everyone signs; Signe signs last, furious.

Scene 2:
Characters: Kaspar, Mateo
Place: Back kitchen, whiteboard by dish pit
Time: Noon
Event: Kaspar tells Mateo to plan capacity beyond permits, “quietly.”
Conflict: Mateo warns about electrical and wastewater loads; Kaspar presses for workarounds.
Story value: Risk
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Tight, pragmatic
Outcome: Mateo agrees to model “hypotheticals” and keep it verbal.

Chapter 3:
Scene 1:
Characters: Alma, Einar, Mateo, Line cook team
Place: Prep kitchen
Time: Afternoon, May pop-up day
Event: Alma dials the “salted kohlrabi, skær, dill pollen” plating and brine.
Conflict: Brine swings too sharp; Mateo tweaks salinity on the fly.
Story value: Craft
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Focused, humming
Outcome: Stable brine; plating sequence locked.

Scene 2:
Characters: Alma, Leif, Diners, FOH
Place: Dining room and pass
Time: Service, first seating
Event: The skær course lands; multiple diners cry; Leif books a second seat that week from the table.
Conflict: FOH wants to slow the course; Alma insists on the tight window.
Story value: Reputation
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Charged, hushed
Outcome: Course becomes the talk of the room; Leif asks for a second reservation card.

Chapter 4:
Scene 1:
Characters: Signe, Kaspar, Alma
Place: Walk-in threshold and office
Time: Next morning
Event: Kaspar pushes for increased skær pulls and full coordinates access.
Conflict: Signe refuses to hand over tide charts; Alma tries to mediate.
Story value: Trust
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Brittle, standoff
Outcome: No charts; meeting ends unresolved.

Scene 2:
Characters: Signe, Kaspar
Place: Alley behind the hall, by delivery bay
Time: Early afternoon
Event: Kaspar corners Signe about volumes and “scaling.”
Conflict: Signe draws a line on sustainability and rights; Kaspar calls it insubordination.
Story value: Supply
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Hot, final
Outcome: Signe walks out; foraging pipeline jeopardized.

Chapter 5:
Scene 1:
Characters: Leif, Alma, FOH, Diners
Place: Dining room
Time: Two nights later, second seating
Event: Leif returns and eats the skær course again, watching the room.
Conflict: He probes Alma at the pass for sourcing; Alma stays opaque.
Story value: Validation
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Anticipatory, appraising
Outcome: Leif leaves wordless, visibly moved.

Scene 2:
Characters: Leif, Editor (via phone), Kaspar (via text)
Place: Leif’s Torvehallerne apartment
Time: Midnight
Event: Leif files an ecstatic rave; pushes for immediate run.
Conflict: Editor worries about overhyping; Leif stakes his name on it.
Story value: Demand
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Wired, decisive
Outcome: Piece publishes at dawn; bookings spike within hours.

Chapter 6:
Scene 1:
Characters: Kaspar, Einar, Contractor, Mateo (arrives late)
Place: Basement utility room
Time: Pre-dawn, off-hours
Event: Installation of an unlicensed recirculating skær tank plumbed to harbor water.
Conflict: Mateo flags backflow and filtration gaps; Kaspar orders it in anyway.
Story value: Safety
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Hushed, illicit
Outcome: Tank runs; paperwork nonexistent.

Scene 2:
Characters: Kaspar, Einar
Place: Loading bay and staff corridor
Time: Early morning
Event: Kaspar instructs Einar to keep the tank “off books.”
Conflict: Einar wants maintenance logs; Kaspar forbids documentation.
Story value: Ethics
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Complicit, uneasy
Outcome: Einar agrees to verbal-only checks; hides the key.

Chapter 7:
Scene 1:
Characters: Mateo, Alma
Place: Prep bench and dish station
Time: Late morning
Event: Mateo prototypes a salinity probe and brine controller for consistency.
Conflict: Probe drifts; Alma needs stable readings before service.
Story value: Competence
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Tinkering, precise
Outcome: Calibrated baseline; controller stabilizes within tolerance.

Scene 2:
Characters: Einar, Line cooks, FOH lead
Place: Kitchen and pass
Time: Evening service
Event: Einar times prep and fire to tide windows; service tightens.
Conflict: Staff resent the stricter clocks; Einar enforces anyway.
Story value: Flow
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Snapped, efficient
Outcome: Courses hit exact texture; tickets clear cleanly.

Chapter 8:
Scene 1:
Characters: Mateo, Einar, Alma
Place: Basement tank room
Time: Late afternoon, squall onset
Event: Storm surge; the new tank coughs air and alarms.
Conflict: Mateo wants to shut down intake and purge; orders clash with the push to hold product.
Story value: Safety
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Claustrophobic, urgent
Outcome: Intake paused; pressure dropping; Kaspar called.

Scene 2:
Characters: Kaspar, Mateo, Einar
Place: Same tank room
Time: Minutes later
Event: Kaspar orders a pump restart to save stock despite Mateo’s warning.
Conflict: Safety protocol vs service demand; Mateo refuses, Kaspar overrules.
Story value: Leadership legitimacy
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Harsh, high-risk
Outcome: Pump restarts; system stabilizes on paper, risks escalate.

chapters: A squall hits, Kaspar orders the tank pump restart, the backflush dumps into the canal, and days later fish float and harbor baths close. (-)
Freja microdoses skær before service and nails three knife-edge pairings as Mateo logs the deviations. (+)
A guest on the pairing course relives a car crash, bolts mid-meal, and Fødevarestyrelsen quietly opens an inspection. (-)
Mateo refuses skær for a pregnant diner and amends HACCP to lock the exemption into the line. (+)
Petra poaches Mateo and two servers and launches a lookalike skær dish across town. (-)
A blogger films Petra’s agar-and-psilocybin prep and posts the fraud, denting her rollout. (+)
Signe halts supply after seeing torn beds, Alma serves a kombu decoy that flops, and a VIP threatens to sue for “withheld experience.” (-)
Einar records shredded eelgrass and the illegal tank and hands the files to Signe and a DTU postdoc, landing a city hearing date. (+)
Alma doses Ingrid to catch a lucid memory, then drinks alone after Ingrid spirals into agitation. (-)
Leif publishes a numbered review naming the menu “a theft,” bookings surge anyway, and Alma decides to end skær. (+)
act_scenes:
Chapter 9:
Scene 1:
Characters: Kaspar, Alma, Mateo, line cooks
Place: Tank room and back dock
Time: Night of the squall, 22:10
Event: Power blips; Kaspar orders the tank pump restarted; the auto-backflush routes to the storm drain feeding the canal.
Conflict: Alma urges waiting for clarity; Kaspar insists on immediate restart to save stock.
Story value: Environmental safety
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Pressured, wet, brittle
Outcome: Pump restarts; unknown discharge volume dumps into runoff.

Scene 2:
Characters: Einar, harbor bath lifeguard, joggers
Place: Canal edge near harbor baths
Time: Three days later, morning
Event: Fish float; lifeguard tapes off baths; Einar films dead bream and murky plume.
Conflict: Lifeguard pushes Einar back from cordon; Einar insists on documenting source.
Story value: Public trust
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Sour, accusatory
Outcome: Baths close; Einar has footage suggesting a point-source near the restaurant outfall.

Chapter 10:
Scene 1:
Characters: Freja, Mateo, Alma
Place: Staff locker and dry storage
Time: Pre-service, Friday 16:45
Event: Freja microdoses skær; Mateo logs prep deviations; Alma signs off pairing matrix.
Conflict: Mateo questions dose calibration; Freja deflects, citing service feel.
Story value: Food safety control
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Tense, conspiratorial
Outcome: Dose remains unofficial; Mateo notes variance in his ledger.

Scene 2:
Characters: Freja, diners (table 6), Mateo
Place: Dining room and pass
Time: Service, 20:10–21:00
Event: Freja nails three knife-edge pairings; guests glow; Mateo time-stamps pours.
Conflict: One diner hesitates at aroma; Freja reframes it as “sea fennel clarity,” persuading.
Story value: Artistic success
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Electric, precise
Outcome: Service lands; Mateo’s data supports the skær’s effect curve.

Chapter 11:
Scene 1:
Characters: Guest (pairing course), server, Alma, Mateo
Place: Chef’s counter
Time: Service, Saturday 19:40
Event: Guest’s memory spirals after a pour; hands shake; he bolts from stool.
Conflict: Alma moves to de-escalate; guest resists help, demands air.
Story value: Guest safety
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Jarring, exposed
Outcome: Guest leaves mid-meal; comped; contact info taken.

Scene 2:
Characters: Fødevarestyrelsen inspector, Alma, Mateo
Place: Office and walk-in
Time: Next business day, 10:30
Event: Quiet inspection opens; logs, sourcing, and dosing practices requested.
Conflict: Inspector asks for validated controls; Mateo’s ledger shows unofficial doses.
Story value: Regulatory risk
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Clinical, tight-lipped
Outcome: Inspector takes copies; promises follow-up.

Chapter 12:
Scene 1:
Characters: Mateo, pregnant diner, server, Alma
Place: Pass and table 12
Time: Service, Thursday 19:20
Event: Server reaches for standard pour; Mateo intercepts, refuses skær for pregnant guest.
Conflict: Server cites pairing menu; Mateo cites duty of care.
Story value: Ethical integrity
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Firm, contained
Outcome: Non-skær alternative served; guest thanks discreetly.

Scene 2:
Characters: Mateo, Alma
Place: Office and HACCP binder station
Time: Post-service, 23:10
Event: Mateo amends HACCP to lock exemption for pregnancy and contraindications.
Conflict: Alma worries it concedes liability; Mateo insists it reduces it.
Story value: Procedural control
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Pragmatic
Outcome: New SOP printed, signed, briefed for lineup.

Chapter 13:
Scene 1:
Characters: Petra, Mateo
Place: Quiet café off-shift
Time: Monday 15:00
Event: Petra poaches Mateo with salary and creative control; hints at new menu.
Conflict: Mateo resists leaving mid-storm; Petra baits with “freedom from Alma’s rules.”
Story value: Loyalty
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Seductive, brittle
Outcome: Mateo stalls but pockets Petra’s draft contract.

Scene 2:
Characters: Petra, two servers from Alma’s team, contractor
Place: Petra’s new kitchen
Time: One week later, morning
Event: Petra launches a lookalike skær dish (agar-and-psilocybin base) in friends-and-family.
Conflict: Server worries about legality; Petra insists it’s “innovative, not illegal.”
Story value: Authenticity
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Hyper, reckless
Outcome: Soft launch proceeds; visuals mimic Alma’s plating.

Chapter 14:
Scene 1:
Characters: Blogger, Petra, sous-chef
Place: Petra’s prep room
Time: Afternoon before service
Event: Blogger films agar-and-psilocybin prep after a “behind-the-scenes” invite.
Conflict: Sous-chef tries to limit angles; blogger insists access was promised.
Story value: Secrecy
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Smug, invasive
Outcome: Clean footage of swap captured.

Scene 2:
Characters: Blogger, followers, Petra
Place: Online; Petra’s dining room reacting
Time: That night, 21:30
Event: Post goes live calling out fraud; diners whisper; a table cancels dessert.
Conflict: Petra confronts blogger in DMs; blogger posts receipts.
Story value: Reputation
Story value charge: Positive (for Alma by comparison), Negative for Petra
Mood: Sharp, schadenfreude
Outcome: Petra’s rollout dented; industry chat pivots back to Alma.

Chapter 15:
Scene 1:
Characters: Signe, Alma, Kaspar
Place: Shore lease, eelgrass beds
Time: Morning low tide
Event: Signe inspects torn beds; halts supply pending recovery.
Conflict: Alma pleads for partial harvest; Signe refuses on principle and law.
Story value: Supply stability
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Stern, ecological
Outcome: Supply cut; delivery schedule wiped.

Scene 2:
Characters: Alma, VIP, service team
Place: Dining room
Time: That evening, 20:50
Event: Alma serves kombu decoy; flavor falls flat; VIP bristles, claims “withheld experience.”
Conflict: Alma cites safety and supply ethics; VIP threatens to sue for misrepresentation.
Story value: Customer satisfaction
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Embarrassed, defensive
Outcome: Comped degustation; legal threat emailed via assistant.

Chapter 16:
Scene 1:
Characters: Einar, Signe
Place: Canal footbridge near outfall
Time: Dawn
Event: Einar records shredded eelgrass and effluent, tags timestamps; shares with Signe.
Conflict: Signe fears blowback on her lease; Einar argues duty to document.
Story value: Evidence
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Cold, resolute
Outcome: Files transferred; chain of custody noted.

Scene 2:
Characters: Einar, DTU postdoc, Signe
Place: University lab office
Time: Next day, 13:00
Event: Postdoc reviews clips and water samples; drafts memo for municipal committee.
Conflict: Postdoc warns about going public pre-hearing; Einar pushes for press.
Story value: Legal leverage
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Measured, strategic
Outcome: City hearing date secured; embargo agreed.

Chapter 17:
Scene 1:
Characters: Alma, Ingrid
Place: Alma’s apartment
Time: Late evening
Event: Alma doses Ingrid to catch a lucid memory; momentary clarity surfaces then slips.
Conflict: Ingrid resists an old memory, becomes agitated; Alma tries to soothe.
Story value: Care vs. harm
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Intimate, fraying
Outcome: Session ends in tears; no stable recall.

Scene 2:
Characters: Alma
Place: Kitchen counter, alone
Time: After midnight
Event: Alma drinks alone, replaying the attempt; deletes a voice memo.
Conflict: Impulse to try again vs. recognition of damage.
Story value: Self-control
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Hollow, guilty
Outcome: She shelves the vial but doesn’t discard it.

Chapter 18:
Scene 1:
Characters: Leif, Alma, diners
Place: Dining room and back alley
Time: Review day, Saturday 18:30
Event: Leif dines, then publishes a numbered review calling the menu “a theft.”
Conflict: Alma debates responding; PR advises silence.
Story value: Public perception
Story value charge: Negative (hit lands), then stabilizes
Mood: Clinical, ruthless
Outcome: Review trends; staff brace for cancellations.

Scene 2:
Characters: Alma, Mateo, Freja
Place: Office after service
Time: 00:20
Event: Bookings surge despite critique; Alma decides to end skær.
Conflict: Freja argues it’s their edge; Mateo backs the exit for safety and legality.
Story value: Ethical direction
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Sober, decisive
Outcome: Alma sets a date to retire skær and drafts guest communication plan.

chapters: Mateo returns overnight, rebuilds prep lists, and steadies the line.
Petra poaches two more servers and Alma cuts seats.
Einar posts a catch-limits board at the pass and Alma makes it policy.
Freja crashes in service from skær withdrawal and Alma benches her.
In the January herring run, Alma and Signe recalibrate salinity and deliver a clean skær-free tasting.
At the February summit, Kaspar signs Dubai LOIs and tightens NDAs.
On supermoon dawn, Alma’s crew outpaces Petra’s RIB to the bridge skerry.
They find torn beds and Petra’s markers scarring the rock.
Alma cuts one final tuft and declares an immediate moratorium to the crew.
That night, Kaspar yanks funding mid-service when Alma serves “Return” and reads the disclosure.
Half the room stays, eats the eelgrass broth, and applauds as regulators step to the pass.
Leif finishes the no-skær menu without scent returning and writes in absence.
The hearing levies fines, orders the tank dismantled, and adopts Signe/DTU stewardship.
Petra pivots to “plant-based memory” and floods socials with copycat content.
Alma reopens smaller, pays staff through the pause, and runs service by Einar’s tide board with published coordinates and limits.
